explanation: The value is 0 at every D1 and GO step and is nonzero only at D2 when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by the common transition, where it is usually 9-10 if the agent has kept choosing a2 for several trials. It is 0 at D2 for every a1 choice and every rare transition, it is often 0 or low (0-6) when a2 is the first choice right after a run of a1, and it drops to about 1-5 late in the episode (after about trial 85).
